verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־ טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃ אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·šan·nō·w·ṯōw ’eṯ- ṭa‘·mōw lip̄·nê ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ way·ḡā·ră·šê·hū way·yê·laḵ ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ tā·mîḏ tə·hil·lā·ṯōw bə·p̄î
verses.literal: Of David when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech so that the king drove him away I will bless the LORD at all times His praise will always be on my lips
verses.literalPt: LOUVAREI ao SENHOR em todo o tempo; o seu louvor estará continuamente na minha boca.

verses.original: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh tiṯ·hal·lêl nap̄·šî yiš·mə·‘ū ‘ă·nā·wîm wə·yiś·mā·ḥū
verses.literal: My soul boasts in the LORD let the oppressed hear and rejoice
verses.literalPt: A minha alma se gloriará no SENHOR; os mansos o ouvirão e se alegrarão.

verses.original: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: gad·də·lū Yah·weh ’it·tî ū·nə·rō·wm·māh šə·mōw yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Magnify the LORD with me let us exalt His name together
verses.literalPt: Engrandecei ao SENHOR comigo; e juntos exaltemos o seu nome.

verses.original: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל־ מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: dā·raš·tî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·‘ā·nā·nî ū·mik·kāl- mə·ḡū·rō·w·ṯay hiṣ·ṣî·lā·nî
verses.literal: I sought the LORD and He answered me He delivered me from all my fears
verses.literalPt: Busquei ao SENHOR, e ele me respondeu; livrou-me de todos os meus temores.

verses.original: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־ יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bî·ṭū ’ê·lāw wə·nā·hā·rū ū·p̄ə·nê·hem ’al- yeḥ·pā·rū
verses.literal: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy their faces shall never be ashamed
verses.literalPt: Olharam para ele, e foram iluminados; e os seus rostos não ficaram confundidos.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ‘ā·nî qā·rā Yah·weh šā·mê·a‘ ū·mik·kāl- ṣā·rō·w·ṯāw hō·wō·šî·‘ōw
verses.literal: This poor man called out and the LORD heard him He saved him from all his troubles
verses.literalPt: Clamou este pobre, e o SENHOR o ouviu, e o salvou de todas as suas angústias.

verses.original: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·neh mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh sā·ḇîḇ lî·rê·’āw way·ḥal·lə·ṣêm
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him and he delivers them
verses.literalPt: O anjo do SENHOR acampa-se ao redor dos que o temem, e os livra.

verses.original: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭa·‘ă·mū ū·rə·’ū kî- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh ’aš·rê hag·ge·ḇer ye·ḥĕ·seh- bōw
verses.literal: Taste and see that the LORD is good blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him
verses.literalPt: Provai, e vede que o SENHOR é bom; bem-aventurado o homem que nele confia.

verses.original: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·r·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh qə·ḏō·šāw kî- ’ên maḥ·sō·wr lî·rê·’āw
verses.literal: Fear the LORD you His saints for those who fear Him lack nothing
verses.literalPt: Temei ao SENHOR, vós, os seus santos, pois nada falta aos que o temem.

verses.original: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא־ יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: kə·p̄î·rîm rā·šū wə·rā·‘ê·ḇū wə·ḏō·rə·šê Yah·weh lō- yaḥ·sə·rū ḵāl ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Young lions go lacking and hungry but those who seek the LORD lack no . . . good thing
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos leões necessitam e sofrem fome, mas àqueles que buscam ao SENHOR bem nenhum faltará.

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî yir·’aṯ Yah·weh ’ă·lam·meḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: Come children listen to me I will teach you the fear of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Vinde, meninos, ouvi-me; eu vos ensinarei o temor do SENHOR.

verses.original: מִֽי־ הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: mî- hā·’îš he·ḥā·p̄êṣ ḥay·yîm ’ō·hêḇ yā·mîm lir·’ō·wṯ ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Who is the man who delights in life who desires to see good days
verses.literalPt: Quem é o homem que deseja a vida, que quer largos dias para ver o bem?

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ṣōr lə·šō·wn·ḵā mê·rā‘ ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā mid·dab·bêr mir·māh
verses.literal: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech
verses.literalPt: Guarda a tua língua do mal, e os teus lábios de falarem o engano.

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: sūr mê·rā‘ wa·‘ă·śêh- ṭō·wḇ baq·qêš šā·lō·wm wə·rā·ḏə·p̄ê·hū
verses.literal: Turn away from evil and do good seek peace and pursue it
verses.literalPt: Aparta-te do mal, e faze o bem; procura a paz, e segue-a.

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־ שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’el- ṣad·dî·qîm wə·’ā·zə·nāw ’el- šaw·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous and His ears are inclined to their cry
verses.literalPt: Os olhos do SENHOR estão sobre os justos, e os seus ouvidos atentos ao seu clamor.

verses.original: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nê Yah·weh bə·‘ō·śê rā‘ lə·haḵ·rîṯ mê·’e·reṣ ziḵ·rām
verses.literal: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil to wipe out all memory of them from the earth
verses.literalPt: A face do SENHOR está contra os que fazem o mal, para desarraigar da terra a memória deles.

verses.original: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־ צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣā·‘ă·qū Yah·weh šā·mê·a‘ ū·mik·kāl- ṣā·rō·w·ṯām hiṣ·ṣî·lām
verses.literal: The righteous cry out and the LORD hears He delivers them from all their troubles
verses.literalPt: Os justos clamam, e o SENHOR os ouve, e os livra de todas as suas angústias.

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־ לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־ דַּכְּאֵי־ ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rō·wḇ Yah·weh lə·niš·bə·rê- lêḇ wə·’eṯ- dak·kə·’ê- rū·aḥ yō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted . . . He saves the contrite in spirit
verses.literalPt: Perto está o SENHOR dos que têm o coração quebrantado, e salva os contritos de espírito.

verses.original: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ ṣad·dîq ū·mik·kul·lām yaṣ·ṣî·len·nū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Many are the afflictions of the righteous but the LORD delivers him from them all
verses.literalPt: Muitas são as aflições do justo, mas o SENHOR o livra de todas.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw ’a·ḥaṯ mê·hên·nāh lō niš·bā·rāh
verses.literal: He protects all his bones not one of them will be broken
verses.literalPt: Ele lhe guarda todos os seus ossos; nem sequer um deles se quebra.

verses.original: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·mō·w·ṯêṯ rā·šā‘ rā·‘āh wə·śō·nə·’ê ṣad·dîq ye’·šā·mū
verses.literal: Evil will slay the wicked and the haters of the righteous will be condemned
verses.literalPt: A malícia matará o ímpio, e os que odeiam o justo serão punidos.

verses.original: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל־ הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pō·w·ḏeh Yah·weh ne·p̄eš ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·lō ye’·šə·mū kāl- ha·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: The LORD redeems His servants and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR resgata a alma dos seus servos, e nenhum dos que nele confiam será punido.
